sample.text: At the start of the review, the editor examines the account in detail. For consistency, the author assesses the wording against the earlier notes. For clarification, the editor identifies the remaining questions for later discussion. Before revising the draft, the editor considers the alternative wording before making revisions. To clarify the organization, the editor examines the arrangement of the supporting material. To preserve useful context, the editor checks the supporting notes for additional context. Before the next revision, the editor lists the suggested changes for the next edition. As the review concludes, the editor examines the revised draft before the next discussion.
